name: Maachah
bio: Maachah, daughter of Abishalom, was the queen mother through the reigns of both Abijam and his son Asa (1 Kings 15:2, 10) — likely Asa's grandmother rather than his literal mother, since "queen mother" in the royal court was an official position rather than strictly a parental title. When Asa came to the throne and did what was right in the LORD's eyes, he removed Maachah from her position as queen mother because she had made a repulsive Asherah pole; Asa cut it down and burned it in the Kidron Valley (1 Kings 15:13).
